### 1. Scene
A mixed meal of pepperoni pizza, sliced roast meat, roasted vegetables, cauliflower and a few rocket leaves.

### 2. Vessel
A rounded-square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:  
**Area = 3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm².**

### 3. Items
Pepperoni pizza; roast meat (possibly lamb or pork); cauliflower; roasted potatoes; roasted aubergine; rocket leaves. The roasted vegetables have a slight oily sheen, accounted for in their energy values rather than as a separate oil portion.

### 4–7. Area, volume, weight and energy
Areas represent non-overlapping shares of the plate. Density is the only reduction applied to gross volume.

| Item | Plate area | Area, cm² | Height, cm | Gross volume, ml | Density, g/ml | Weight, g | kcal/100 g | Energy, kcal |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Pepperoni pizza | 20% | 106 | 1.3 | 138 | 0.95 | 131 | 280 | 367 |
| Sliced roast meat | 13% | 69 | 1.4 | 97 | 1.0 | 97 | 250 | 243 |
| Cauliflower | 6% | 32 | 2.4 | 77 | 0.55 | 42 | 25 | 11 |
| Roasted potatoes | 7% | 37 | 2.4 | 89 | 0.65 | 58 | 150 | 87 |
| Roasted aubergine | 3% | 16 | 2.0 | 32 | 0.65 | 21 | 100 | 21 |
| Rocket leaves | 2% | 11 | 1.0 | 11 | 0.15 | 2 | 25 | 1 |
| **Total** | **51%** | | | | | **351** | | **730** |

### 8. Sanity check
About half the plate is covered, with the pizza and meat providing most of the weight and energy. **Approximately 350 g and 730 kcal** is plausible; the few leaves contribute only about 2 g. The main uncertainties are the meat type and the vegetables’ oil content.
